item.title: Co-exposure to CO2 and heatwaves and the risk for diabetes: a multi-center spatial epidemiological study in China
item.description: Figure 1. Associations of CO₂ and heatwaves with the risks for diabetes/prediabetes. a Single-exposure crude models; (b) single-exposure models adjusting for age, sex, ethnicity, marital status, educational level, occupation, and urbanicity; © single-exposure models additionally adjusting for alcohol drinking, smoking, sleep duration, sedentary time, physical activity, and diet upon (b); (d) single-exposure models additionally adjusting for PM2.5, O₃, CO, NO₂, and SO₂ upon ©; (e) two-exposure models adjusting for all covariates in (d). CI, confidence interval; FBG, fasting blood glucose; OR, odds ratio. *p<0.05, **p<0.01, ***p<0.001.
